title: Gaming Grottos Modpack
description: A lightweight Fabric modpack made for The Gaming Grotto SMP, focused on quality-of-life improvements, multiplayer convenience, and a smooth vanilla-plus experience.
body:
## The Gaming Grotto Modpack

The Gaming Grotto Modpack is a **vanilla-plus Fabric modpack** focused on performance, quality-of-life improvements, and multiplayer convenience, while keeping the core Minecraft experience intact. It is the **official modpack** for The Gaming Grotto Minecraft server.
